formation_structure.artillery: Steward and Lava cover complementary eastern segments. Their ranges also contain central enemies, so target competition is explicitly charged against artillery output. 12F adds a scheduled western-return window rather than an assumed posthumous kill.
formation_structure.medical: The medics have separate upper and lower responsibilities. Reciprocal healing is not claimed. Column-3 placement increases separation from the eastern artillery patrol, but exact client attack range and targeting remain unverified.
formation_structure.opening: Retain the prior central and outer opening positions. Lancet leaves before frame 1380. Hibiscus replaces the opening upper medical responsibility from column 3; Ansel later inherits Lancet's vacated tile.
formation_structure.outer: Melantha retains upper interception with healing. Cardigan retains lower interception with healing; unsupported self-healing is excluded.
formation_structure.protected_routes: Gallus clears western #1, Melantha clears eastern #3, temporary Durin inherits eastern #4, and Popukar eventually clears western #2. Cardigan separates officers from the detained lower civilian.
formation_structure.terminal: Midnight, Beagle, Melantha, Cardigan, both medics, Steward and Durin form the final eight operators.

tactical_thesis: Preserve the demonstrated opening interception while withdrawing Lancet before its fatal exposure. Move the main medics to column 3, where they can heal the eastern casters, central blockers and outer interceptors. Steward and Lava use overlapping eastern arts coverage; a scheduled 12F deployment extends artillery clearance into its western return. Melantha remains the medically supported upper interceptor. Separate lower interception from delayed western roadblock clearance, and replace both central pioneers before terminal clearance. Artillery damage, healer survival and blocking capacity are explicit proof obligations; none is inferred from civilian arrival or roadblock destruction.

Redeployment charging and action legality must be checked against actual runtime DP; no refund is assumed.
